exact.Pozitif KPI'da yüksek, negatif KPI'da dü: For positive KPIs, higher actuals are better; for negative KPIs, lower actuals are better. Piecewise linear interpolation is used between points.
exact.Q1, Q2, Q3 ve Q4 artık bağımsız çeyrek d: Q1, Q2, Q3, and Q4 are independent quarterly values; source values are preserved unchanged.
exact.“1 Ocak–...” biçimindeki eski kümülatif: When legacy cumulative columns in the “1 January–...” format are detected, summable KPIs are first separated into independent quarters so historical files are not counted twice.
exact.İşaretli KPI'larda dolu çeyrekler toplan: For selected KPIs, populated quarters are summed. Period targets at 80/100/120 are calculated as annual target ÷ 4 × populated-quarter count.
exact.İşaretli olmayan oran, skor ve anlık dur: For unselected rate, score, and point-in-time KPIs, values are not summed; the latest populated quarter in the selected period is used.
exact.Toplanan KPI'da kümülatif gerçekleşen ÷: For summed KPIs, the projection is cumulative actual ÷ populated quarters × 4; for other KPIs, it is the latest populated-quarter value.
exact.Pazar payı, marka performansı, brüt marj: Market share, brand performance, gross margin, overhead ratio, NPS, new customer, Logistics OTIF, inventory turnover, and CBA scores default to the latest-period rule.
exact.KPI Ayarları ekranındaki seçimler bu tar: Selections on the KPI Settings screen are stored in this browser and immediately applied to all summaries, scores, projections, and CSV output.

exact.İşaretli KPI'lar toplanır, dönem hedefle: Selected KPIs are summed, period targets are prorated, and results are projected to year-end.

Enter percentage points: 80 = 80%, 100 = 100%. Entering 0.8 is treated as 0.8%.
exact.80% altındaki şirket gerçekleşmelerinde: For company achievement below 80%, the coefficient is 0. Values above 120% are treated as 120%. Linear interpolation is applied between 80-100-120; the result is then multiplied by the letter-grade multiplier and title-based salary coefficient. A special scenario replaces the standard result only for the same title, grade, and target rate. The final coefficient cannot exceed 6 for Director, 3 for Manager, and 2 for Specialist and below.
exact.Ara değerler 80 / 100 / 120 hedef noktal: Intermediate values are calculated by linear interpolation between the 80 / 100 / 120 target points. Settings are stored in this browser.
exact.80 / 100 / 120 hedef noktaları ve maaş k: The 80 / 100 / 120 target points and salary coefficient are managed here. Intermediate values are calculated linearly between these three points. Fixed caps: Director 6, Manager 3, Specialist and below 2.
exact.Bireysel performans harf sonucu çarpanla: These are the multipliers for individual performance letter grades.
exact.Birebir eşleşen unvan + harf + şirket he: For an exact title + grade + company target-rate match, the special coefficient replaces the standard result. Enter percentage points in the target field; 100 = 100%, 0.8 = 0.8%. The special coefficient cannot exceed the title's fixed cap.

The Title Turnover Rate view divides title exits only by that title's average employee count. Pasor roles are grouped under Pasor Sales Advisor; Total Turnover covers all titles.

exact.Geldiği gün, ilgili kişi-ay için PDKS li: Days Present is the number of employee-ID passage rows in the PDKS list for the relevant person-month. Total Remote Days = Remote Days + External Remote Days. Turnstile and external-system records are not included in remote-day calculations. Hours Worked uses the gun_saat source field; when empty, calisma_saat_toplam is used. Required Hours are calculated only for days with a PDKS record. Weekends are 0 hours; public holidays, half days, and early-departure exceptions follow the visible calendar rules. Difference = Hours Worked - Required Hours. Positive values indicate excess time and negative values indicate missing time.
